{{Quote|This one is beginning to doubt the wisdom of our council. Every pack needz a longfang, or itz hunters will scatter after their own prey.|Saba Sebatyne to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Dark Nest I: The Joiner King">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>}}
'''Longfang''' was a term which meant the leader of a group, or pack.

It was used by the [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] [[Saba Sebatyne]] to describe how when [[Alema Rar]], [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], and [[Zekk]] had abandoned their posts, the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi Council]] could not make a firm decision on what to do, because it had more than one [[Grand Master/Legends|leader]]. It was later used by Saba when referring to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Skywalker]] before the [[Battle of Kuat (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Kuat]].
